semantic_atoms.source_span: services/consciousness_daemon.py :: timing constants + workspace update loop
semantic_atoms.observed: WORKSPACE_UPDATE_INTERVAL_S is 60 seconds at the pinned historical SHA. The running loop repeatedly calls _update_workspace() and then sleeps for that interval.

The workspace refresh gathers live hardware, mood and ego data, refreshes proprioception caches, ticks additional internal controllers, derives energy from CPU load, and replaces the in-memory WorkspaceSnapshot under a lock.
WorkspaceSnapshot carries timestamp, body/ego, mood, memory, identity, environment, attention_focus, mood_value and energy_level. workspace_state persists corresponding fields and indexes timestamp.

Only every fifth workspace update is inserted into workspace_state; old snapshots are bounded by MAX_WORKSPACE_HISTORY. On startup the newest workspace_state row is reloaded into the mutable current workspace.
